correctness.rationale: For the inclusive ambient Euclidean filtration, independently reconstructed the integer point set and every clique at squared thresholds 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. Checked all 1,870 certificate pairs for genuine covers and disjointness, and topologically sorted all 13,032 oriented covers. The critical vectors are exactly (1,13,0), (1,7,0), (1,0,9), (1,0,1), (1,0,1), (1,0,1). With a single 0-cell and only 1-cells or only 2-cells remaining, discrete Morse theory gives the asserted wedges. Exact intersections of triples of the 14 supporting planes reproduce the convex hull vertices; the geometric boundary triangulation lies in squared scale 6. At squared scale 12, all 92 maximal cliques are separated from the origin by their vertex sums (minimum vertex pairing 13). The radial map restricts to a degree ±1 homeomorphism on the common boundary, so its class generates each rank-one integral H2, the inclusion from scale 6 surjects with free kernel of rank eight, and the inclusions between the three sphere stages have degree ±1 and are homotopy equivalences. The only squared-4 edges are square diagonals, each homologous relative to its endpoints to the boundary path, giving surjectivity on H1 and the two stated bar multiplicities. The distance set verifies that no extra threshold lies in the claimed interval; no death at or after squared 14 is inferred from the frozen proof.
residual_risks: Relies on the standard acyclic discrete Morse matching theorem; this is not a formal proof in a proof assistant.

value.rationale: As originally posed, the precise onset of integral stabilization in an Archimedean solid is a meaningful invariant, and the radial-generator proof is mathematically informative. As a stand-alone claim now assessed, however, the strict cutoff at squared 14 leaves no exact invariant or map not already covered by the distinct complete Euclidean result, whose shared collapses give a stronger conclusion. The differing certificate technique is not itself a new general theorem or a distinct invariant claimed by this finding.
residual_risks: The assessment of present distinct value does not deny possible historical priority or the utility of independent corroboration.
